description: This Java class 'CompressedSubscriptions' manages local subscriptions for distributing topic data as hash sequences, supporting operations such as adding/removing topics, updating hash codes, and exporting subscription updates. It integrates with an Akka actor system and extends 'AbstractSubscriptions'.

classes.name: CompressedSubscriptions
classes.description: Final class managing compacted topic subscriptions using hash codes, supporting updates, equality checks, and export functions.

methods.name: CompressedSubscriptions.of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new CompressedSubscriptions instance with provided hash seeds.

methods.name: hashTopic
methods.description: Generates a ByteString hash for a given topic string.

methods.name: onNewTopic
methods.description: Handles addition of a new topic, updating hash mappings and internal state.

methods.name: onRemovedTopic
methods.description: Handles removal of a topic, updating hash counts and internal state.

methods.name: getSeeds
methods.description: Returns the collection of hash function seeds used.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports current subscription updates, forcing update if specified.
